title: Proposal Pack
description: Phase 4.6 — a versioned commercial proposal the agency sends to the brand after the discovery call. Forks structured content from the discovery prep pack (Phase 4.5) and adds proposal-specific sections: executive summary, objectives recap, deliverables, fee, usage rights, exclusivity, timeline, exclusions, next steps. Generation is gated on the agent explicitly confirming pricing + deliverables — slides cannot render until the commercial gate is passed. Each version is a single source of truth for that round of proposal; the confirmed commercial values write into `deal.proposal.*` (canonical). Stored at `data/deals/{deal_id}/proposal_packs/v{N}.json` (gitignored). See `docs/proposal_pack_workflow.md`.

proposal_pack_id.description: Globally unique identifier. Format: `pp_{deal_id_short}_v{N}` (e.g. `pp_2026_q2_alo-yoga_jane-doe_v3`). The `pp_` prefix distinguishes from prep packs (`prep_*`).

deal_id.description: FK to the Phase 4 deal. The deal's `proposal.proposal_pack_ids[]` array references all versions; `proposal.latest_proposal_pack_id` points to the current `is_latest: true` version.

parent_version.description: Which version this regenerated from. Null/absent for v1. Linear history.

is_latest.description: Exactly one version per deal_id at any time.

generation.description: Provenance + parameters for this version. Parallels discovery_prep_pack.generation; same versioning model.

trigger.description: agent_initiated_v1: first version, agent clicked 'draft proposal' after passing commercial gate. agent_*regenerate: NL-feedback regen of various scopes. negotiation_response: regen triggered by brand pushback recorded in deal.proposal.negotiation_log[]; this version is bidirectionally linked to that log entry.

pre_generation_guidance.description: Free-text guidance the agent provided BEFORE generation fired. Example: 'Lead the exec summary with the audience-fit data; brand said on the call they need to convince their CMO who's data-driven.'

regeneration_feedback.description: Natural-language feedback on parent version. Populated when version > 1.

target_sections.description: For section/per-slide regen: which sections were rebuilt. Untargeted sections carry from parent_version.

negotiation_log_entry_ref.description: If trigger=negotiation_response: ISO-timestamp of the deal.proposal.negotiation_log[] entry this version responds to. Closes the bidirectional link between proposal_pack version history and the deal's negotiation audit log.

context_snapshot.description: Frozen upstream context this version was generated from. Same lock-on-generation pattern as discovery_prep_pack.context_snapshot.

forked_from_prep_pack_id.description: FK to the discovery prep pack version that this proposal forks from. Slide content (talent_overview, audience_snapshot, recent_work) is lifted from this prep pack. If null, the proposal was generated without a prior discovery deck (rare — e.g. for repeat brands).

discovery_debrief_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of `deal.lead.discovery_debrief` at generation time. If the canonical block later evolves (e.g. agent adds notes after a follow-up call), this version stays anchored. Shape mirrors `deal.lead.discovery_debrief`.

comparable_brand_deal_ids.description: Past brand_deals used as commercial + creative comparables.

external_research_refreshed.description: Was Exa research re-run for this proposal? Default false — proposal trusts the discovery prep's external research. Refresh recommended if >14d since prep pack v1.

external_research.description: Populated only if external_research_refreshed=true. Same shape as discovery_prep_pack.context_snapshot.external_research.

context_artefacts.description: Files uploaded by the agent to augment generation context — briefs, notes, transcripts, reference material. Each parsed (pypdf / python-docx / text reader), LLM-summarised, and optionally signal-extracted. Agent can tag relevance to demote/exclude from generation.

commercial_proposal.description: The LLM's commercial proposal + the agent's confirmation event. SLIDES CANNOT RENDER until `confirmed_at` is set. On confirmation, the confirmed values write into `deal.proposal.*` (canonical) — this block holds the provenance.

llm_proposed.description: What the LLM proposed, with rationale per field. Built from briefing's commercial_range + objectives heard + comparables + scope/budget signals from discovery_debrief.

rationale.description: Why this specific deliverable was proposed (links to a stated objective or pain point from the debrief).

fee_rationale.description: How the fee was derived. Cites commercial_range + budget_signal + comparable_deal_ids.

milestone.description: e.g. 'Contract signed', 'Concept approval', 'First draft delivered', 'Live posting', 'Final report'.

payment_terms.description: e.g. '50% upon contract execution, 50% upon final delivery, NET-30'. Free-text but conventional patterns.

exclusions.description: Explicit list of what is NOT included. Clarity reduces friction during execution. e.g. 'Paid amplification beyond 60d whitelisting', 'Original music licensing', 'Additional revisions beyond 2 rounds'.

overall_rationale.description: Top-level rationale tying the whole proposal together — references the discovery debrief signals it responds to. The LLM's pitch to the agent for why this is the right proposal.

proposed_at.description: When the LLM completed Stage C (commercial proposal). Slides cannot render until confirmed_at is also set.

confirmed_at.description: When the agent passed the commercial gate. ABSENT = slides not yet rendered. Setting this triggers Stage D (slide generation) AND copies values into deal.proposal.*.

confirmed_overrides.description: Agent's edits to LLM-proposed values, captured per field. If empty, agent accepted all LLM values verbatim. If non-empty, each entry records the override + optional reasoning. Powers analytics (do we systematically overprice / underprice vs comparables?).

note.description: Why the override. Optional but encouraged.

slides.description: Generated only after commercial gate passed. Forks talent_overview / audience_snapshot / recent_work / fit_angle slides from the source discovery prep pack; adds proposal-specific slides (executive_summary, objectives_recap, recommendation, deliverables, timeline, investment, usage_rights, exclusivity, exclusions, next_steps_proposal). Same `live_body` + `leave_behind_extension` + `speaker_notes` + `sources` shape as discovery prep pack slides.

agent_edits.description: Append-only audit log of direct edits to this version (no LLM regen). Same shape as discovery_prep_pack.agent_edits[].

type.description: What kind of artefact this is. Drives how the LLM weights it during generation — brand_brief gets highest weight; reference_material is supplementary.

role.description: Generation weighting. primary_input: heavily influences output. supplementary: cited if relevant. reference: available but not actively used.

stored_filepath.description: Relative path to the uploaded raw file. v0.1: `data/deals/{deal_id}/context_uploads/{artefact_id}_{filename}`. v2: S3 key.

parser.description: v0.1: pypdf (PDF) / python_docx (Word) / text_reader (txt, md). v2: external_transcript_link (Otter / Fireflies / Grain URL — no parsing, just reference).

parsed_text.description: Raw extracted text. Truncated for very large files (configurable cap, default 100k chars). Preserved for the life of the deal; purged on archive.

external_url.description: Used when parser=external_transcript_link. URL to the transcript on the recording service (Otter/Fireflies/Grain). No content extraction in v0.1; v2 may fetch the transcript via the service's API.

llm_summary.description: LLM-generated summary of the artefact's content. Used as compressed input during proposal generation (full parsed_text reserved for direct-cite needs).

llm_extracted_signals.description: Optional structured extraction from the artefact (e.g. brand_brief → stated objectives, deliverables requested, budget mentioned). Used to seed the discovery_debrief block on the deal record.

relevance_tag.description: Agent's manual tagging. `drop` = excluded from generation; `low` = available but de-prioritised; `context` = supplementary background; `core` = heavily weighted.

include_in_generation.description: Hard inclusion gate. Set to false to fully exclude (different from relevance_tag=drop in that it's a binary switch the agent can toggle without re-uploading).

type.description: Drives renderer layout. Proposal-specific types: executive_summary (the one slide the buyer's boss reads); objectives_recap (lifts discovery_debrief.objectives_heard to confirm we listened); recommendation (the angle/concept); deliverables (table); investment (fee + payment terms); usage_rights / exclusivity / exclusions (commercial); next_steps_proposal (what brand does to move forward). Forked types from discovery: talent_overview / audience_snapshot / recent_work. agency_process is renamed from discovery's `process` for clarity.

forked_from_prep_slide_id.description: If this slide was forked from the discovery prep pack rather than generated fresh, the prep pack's slide_id is captured here. Used by the renderer to flag (in editor mode) which slides are inherited vs new — agent can choose to re-generate forked slides if discovery context evolved.

table.description: For deliverables / timeline / investment slides. Renderer turns this into a styled table.
